content.comment_body: I'm experiencing the same connection issue. I'm using [product_name] [version_no] on a new [product_name]. This is my first time working with a [company_name] PLC and I'm finding it quite frustrating that it won't connect easily. My setup is a Windows 10 computer with a USB Realtek Ethernet adapter, which works fine for other programs. I've also tested with two other USB network adapters but encountered the same problem. Both automatic and manual IP configurations haven't allowed me to connect. When I click the refresh icon, the correct MAC address appears and shows the correct IP, subnet mask, gateway, and MAC address from the [product_name] device, so some data is being read from it. However, along the top, the "Connect: Ethernet ..." field is blank and there's nothing listed in the dropdown menu.
What is the IP address currently assigned to the USB adapter?

Here are the settings I've tried: IP address for the Ethernet adapter: 192.168.0.1 and 192.168.0.100. Subnet: 255.255.255.0. Default gateway: left blank and also tried 192.168.0.1. DNS: left blank. What configuration do you recommend?

Have you made sure the correct network interface is selected? For testing, I set my USB Ethernet adapter as follows and had no trouble connecting [product_name] [version_no] with the USB Ethernet adapter. As a test, I set the [product_name]'s IP to 192.168.0.3.
I've applied the same IPv4 settings you described. The interface selection box remains empty though, with no options listed in the dropdown menu.
That means [product_name] software does not detect your USB adapter. Any idea why this happens? I'm not sure.
Is there a newer version of [product_name] available to update to? I'm currently using [version_no].
No, [product_name] [version_no] is the latest release at the moment.

I've encountered the same issue and discovered the reason. [product_name] devices require a static IPv4 address of 198.168.0.254 with a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0. Most Ethernet adapters default to dynamic IP, so you need to switch to a static IPv4 address to connect. In my case, my work PC doesn't grant administrator access, so I must contact IT each time I need to use this configuration. I'm still searching for an alternative approach. I haven't found any clear instructions from [company_name] about connecting the device to a PC. If anyone has better guidance, please share.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing challenges connecting a new [product_name] device to a PC using [product_name] [version_no] and different USB Ethernet adapters on Windows 10. While device details such as MAC address and network settings are visible, the interface selection dropdown remains empty, preventing a proper connection. Setting a static IPv4 address is necessary; however, lack of admin access on work computers complicates this further. Users expressed frustration, noting that clear setup instructions from [company_name] are lacking.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an easy setup process to connect their PC to the [product_name] device, ideally without advanced network configuration or needing administrator rights. They are looking for straightforward and accessible documentation to help with connection.
